title: Boskin Commission's 1.1% CPI overstatement
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Boskin Commission's 1.1% CPI overstatement, about 1990s at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So there was a crime going on which the Bosan Commission was committing against the American people by putting in a 1.1% overstatement in the CPI by hand

plain: A mathematician and commentator, Eric Weinstein, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that in the 1990s in Washington the Boskin Commission, a government panel on economic statistics, committed what he calls a crime against the American people. According to Weinstein, the panel inserted by hand a 1.1 percent overstatement into the CPI, the official measure of how fast prices rise. He tells it as an example of officials quietly shaping what the public is told.
